description:
DECIDED 2026-09-06. Silent wrong answer for any ported Elixir arithmetic.

  expr     fz    Elixir
  7 / 2     3     3.5
  1 / 2     0     0.5

kernel.fz:118 declares '@spec integer / integer :: integer' deliberately, and there is
no div/2 or rem/2. Elixir's / is ALWAYS float division; div/2 is integer division;
rem/2 is the remainder. Elixir has no % operator at all.

Scope:
  - / on (integer, integer) returns float
  - add Kernel.div/2 and Kernel.rem/2
  - decide the fate of fz's % operator (Elixir has none) -- keep as fz-specific or retire
  - migrate every in-tree user: runtime library (Range.count uses ((last-first)/step)+1)
    and fixtures2

This is a breaking change with a real migration. It is worth it because the oracle
harness makes Elixir the definition of correct, and an integer / is a trap that the
oracle only catches when a fixture happens to divide.
title: Adopt Elixir division semantics: / always returns float, add div/2 and rem/2
